description: Answers 'when does ES roll next - and what back-adjustment did the roll add?' Give a root (ES, CL, GC and more) or ALL for every market; optionally start and end. Returns the roll calendar for all 139 futures markets since 2007: for each front-month contract its first and last date as front month, expiry, the next contract, the roll date, trading days before expiry, and the back-adjustment added to its prices in the continuous series. The current front month carries an estimated next roll date.

root.description: Futures root, e.g. ES, CL, GC, or ALL.

name: get_futures_rolls
title: Get futures roll calendar
